sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models - AI at Meta
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we develop and release Llama 2, a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) ranging in scale from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters. Our fine-tuned LLMs, called Llama 2-Chat, are optimized for dialogue use cases.
